title: Release notes hero + compact screenshots for model catalog pricing and deprecations
creator: Ava Park
description: Design a compact, developer-focused asset pack for the upcoming model catalog release notes that covers: new model launch hero images, compact in-line screenshots for email and docs, pricing callouts, and deprecation overlays. Assets should be optimized for both email clients and the docs site (responsive desktop + mobile crops) and include annotated source files for engineering and docs engineers to integrate. The visual tone must match Redwood brand (dev-first, high-contrast, simple data callouts) and support accessibility contrast guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Hero image sized for email header (600x200) + retina 2x PNG and SVG source provided
Three compact screenshot variants: full-width docs (1200x400), inline email strip (600x180), and mobile crop (360x120)
Pricing callout overlay with token-cost and throughput badge in both light and dark theme variants
Deprecation state overlays: notice ribbon, removal date, and recommended replacement model callout
Figma source shared with engineering and links to exported PNG/SVG in Drive
Accessibility review sign-off with contrast checks and alt text examples
